# Tru8 — Evidence Research API

> Submit a claim or URL. Get structured evidence from 30+ sources, classified by source tier (primary/reporting/commentary) and type (data/official/news/analysis/opinion/academic). No verdicts — organised evidence.

## API

Base: https://api.trueight.com/api/v1/agent
Auth: X-API-Key header
Docs: https://www.trueight.com/developers

Endpoints:
- POST /agent/check — Smart endpoint, automatic tier fallback (lookup → consensus → quick → full)
- POST /agent/lookup — Cached prior analysis (£0.02, instant)
- POST /agent/quick — Web search + heuristic classification (£0.07, ~15s)
- POST /agent/full — Full 30+ source pipeline (£0.15, ~60-90s)
- Consensus tier (£0.03, cross-user aggregate) — reachable via /agent/check with max_tier=consensus
- GET /agent/result/{id} — Retrieve completed check (free)
- POST /agent/batch — Up to 10 claims (per-claim pricing, async)

Payment: Prepaid credits, x402 (USDC/SIWE), or Skyfire (JWT)

## MCP Server

Package: tru8-mcp (Python)
Tools: tru8_check (with max_tier param), tru8_get_result, tru8_get_result_raw
Compatible with Claude, GPT, Gemini, and any MCP-capable agent.

## Response

Returns: claims, elements, evidence with tier/type classification, element-evidence mapping with relationship (supports/challenges/context), orientation summary. Optional: computed analytics, manifest signing for tamper evidence.
